content: Implemented typed extension and render-snapshot foundations. jutsu-audio-extensions provides validated stable dotted type IDs, versioned typed parameter descriptors, separate synth/effect/generator factories and registries, duplicate/kind/schema/value validation, typed instantiation, and structured unavailable-type context. jutsu-audio-engine provides private immutable Send+Sync RenderSnapshot data with project revision/audio format, processor specs, graph connections, output node, and build-time graph reference validation. Mock synth/effect/generator tests prove registration, discovery, instantiation, and missing-type failure. TDD red evidence: both integration suites first failed on absent APIs; added parameter/type-ID tests failed before validation implementation. Fresh validation: format and Clippy with warnings denied exit 0; full workspace tests 24 passed, 0 failed. Linked contract document. No commit or push.
